statement: A guard that keeps a lint job a gate must pin what the linter is pointed at, not only how it reports. 2026-11-17: #735's workflow-lint guard refused --no-exit-codes, severity filters, continue-on-error and || true, but passed a workflow that narrowed zizmor's input from . to .github/workflows. That drops both Action definitions (21 files linted to 19) and the job stays green. Fix: refuse any input but the full root, and every other narrowing route the tool's --help offers (zizmor: --collect, working-directory, cd). Prove each refusal by running the old guard on the same mutation and showing it passed. Corollary: an ignore added in case the tool flags a line is a latent hole. Compare ignores the tool reports as used (36) against ignores written (37) and remove the unused one.
